definitions.explanation: Contemporary poetry, especially free verse written in modern colloquial Japanese, as opposed to classical or fixed-form poetry such as tanka and haiku.

examples.japanese: {現代詩|げんだいし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{現代詩|げんだいし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{詩人|しじん}→詩人：03171_shijin⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: He is known as a poet of contemporary free verse.

examples.japanese: {現代詩|げんだいし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{定型|ていけい}→定型：12349_teikei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧とらわれず、⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧な⟦{言葉|ことば}づかい→言葉づかい：14167_kotobazukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}かれる→書く：00477_kaku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Modern poetry is often written in free language, unbound by fixed forms.

notes:
Poetry written in modern colloquial Japanese, typically as free verse without fixed syllable counts. It contrasts with traditional fixed forms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {現代詩|げんだいし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write modern poetry
- {現代詩|げんだいし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{詩人|しじん}→詩人：03171_shijin⟧: a contemporary poet

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{短歌|たんか}→短歌：15358_tanka⟧: tanka — fixed 5-7-5-7-7 form
- ⟦{俳句|はいく}→俳句：00083_haiku⟧: haiku — fixed 5-7-5 form
- ⟦{詩|し}→詩：02139_shi⟧: poem; poetry — the general word, of which {現代詩|げんだいし} is one type
